method: Geocentric Earth-Moon-Sun numerical integration (planar, LSODA) with the coupling injected as a differential solar free-fall acceleration eta*xi_E*g_sun*s_hat; ephemeris fit adjusting the lunar initial state, Earth-mass scale, and secular tidal acceleration by nonlinear least squares on ranges sampled at the real INPOP19a epochs; residual-channel extraction identical to the headline design (step_056).
scope: Forward dynamical transfer-function measurement on a controlled integrator. Not an IMCCE INPOP or JPL DE430 source-level refit; the planetary, relativistic, lunar-figure and station-geometry sectors are not modelled.
control_note: Standard Nordtvedt range response ~12.9 m per unit eta; the planar integrator's emergent value is reported above. The transfer fraction F is convention-free (ratio of post-fit to pre-fit signature), so the control validates physics fidelity rather than entering the closure quantity.

scenario_B_free_harmonics.note: Physical-parameter fit plus free harmonic amplitudes at non-target lunar-theory frequencies (2D, D+-M) -- a conservative upper bound on periodic-term absorption unavailable to a real dynamical ephemeris.

transfer_summary.interpretation: F ~ 1 means the residual-channel estimand carries the full physical coupling through an ephemeris-class fit; F << 1 would mean ephemeris absorption.
